Lessons.Title: Points and Lines All Around
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will practice identifying parallel and intersecting lines and drawing them.

2021 lesson activities: Warm-up: Which One Doesn’t Belong: Four-sided Shapes (10 minutes); Activity 1: Spot Lines and Line Segments (15 minutes); Activity 2: Draw and Design with Lines (20 minutes); Cool-down: Word Fun (5 minutes)
Corrected mathematical focus: Use directional alignment and common points to distinguish parallel from intersecting lines in drawings and surroundings.

Edulytics authored guidance: Inspect original map or classroom sketch for two lines with the same direction. Find or draw segments that intersect; indicate the point of intersection. Include at least three sets of parallels and segments forming right angles in the drawing, as the original source asks.
First-party Cool-down (not publisher assessment): Draw two parallel segments and a transversal; mark intersections.
Images, drawing/protractor accuracy, partner tasks and the gated original publisher Cool-down require original task evidence and teacher/visual review.
